Deserialization vulnerability in logback-core affecting versions before 1.5.35. Fixed in 1.5.35. Waiting for upstream SonarQube to upgrade logback-core. The vulnerable dependency is embedded in compiled application JARs and cannot be patched via JAR replacement.

Fixed in logback-core 1.5.35. The 1.5.x line requires Java 11+; the 1.3.x line is the last Java-8-compatible series and is no longer receiving backports. Stargate is currently pinned to Java 8 by its maven-enforcer rule. Will bump to 1.5.x when stargate supports Java 11+.
